lane: تعارّ 6 _He awoke from his sleep,_ (S, A, O,) _in the night, with a sound,_ or _cry,_ (S, O,) or _speaking,_ or _talking:_ (A:) _he was sleepless, and turned over upon the bed, by night, speaking,_ or _talking,_ (A, K,) _and with a sound,_ or _cry, and,_ as some say, _stretching._ (TA.) A'Obeyd says that some derive it [as Z does] from عِرَارٌ, signifying the “ crying ” of a male ostrich; but that he knows not whether it be so or not. (TA.)

entries.text: تعار، ككتاب: جبل ببلاد قيس، ورجال. وتعر، كمنع: صاح. وجرح تعار، ككتان: لا يرقأ. والتعر، محركة: اشتعال الحرب.
